snippet.title: HELLDIVERS 2 – Into the Unjust | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Set coordinates for the Terminid Hive Worlds – and pack the extra-strength bug spray. We’re exterminating the galaxy’s most disgusting infestation in a patriotic payback mission of no mercy.

Abhorrent new enemy types, thrilling missions, strange worlds and spectacular beasts await the bravest Helldiver units. Did somebody call pest control? #helldivers2 #gaming #helldivers #games #playstation #xbox
